label: HPE Aruba CX 8360-48Y6C
description: HPE Aruba Networking CX 8360-48Y6C 1RU leaf: 48x 1/10/25G SFP28 ports (4 MACsec) plus 6x 40/100G QSFP28 uplinks (2 MACsec). QSFP28 uplinks split 4x 25G/10G or 2x 50G in split mode.
notes: HPE Aruba Networking CX 8360 v2 family. I/O census from the QuickSpecs Technical Specifications table, row I/O ports and slots (https://www.hpe.com/us/en/collaterals/collateral.a50004274enw.html, version 23, 15 June 2026), cross-read against the family datasheet a50002121enw Product capabilities list (https://www.hpe.com/psnow/downloadDoc/HPE%20Networking%20CX8360%20Switch%20Series-a50002121enw.pdf?id=a50002121enw). AOS-CX numbers the front panel sequentially from 1/1/1, so QSFP+/QSFP28 cages continue the SFP group. All QSFP ports except those on the 48XT4C support optional 4x10G/4x25G breakout cables - a transceiver mode on the cage, not extra front-panel ports, so no extra interfaces are modelled. 50G is supported on the 16Y2C, 32Y4C and 48Y6C (QuickSpecs Key Features) but is not modelled: the catalogue port shapes stop at each cage native speed. This model: "44 ports of 1GbE/10GbE/25GbE (SFP/SFP+/SFP28) / 4 ports of 10GbE/25GbE (SFP+/SFP28) with MACsec / 4 ports of 40GbE/100GbE (QSFP+/QSFP28) / 2 ports of 40GbE/100GbE (QSFP+/QSFP28) with MACsec" - 48 Y ports (4 of them MACsec) and 6 C ports (2 of them MACsec), which is the 48Y6C shape the catalogue already had. Up to 22 ports of 50G. Switching capacity 4.8 Tbps, 5 fans, 2 PSUs. SKUs: JL704C front-to-back, JL705C back-to-front. Installation guide: https://arubanetworking.hpe.com/techdocs/hardware/switches/8360/IGSG/Aruba_8360_IGSG.pdf
